# SlickKit

> SlickKit is a privacy-first, client-side utility suite for everyday PDF, image, and media processing. Every operation executes 100% in local browser memory (RAM) using compiled WebAssembly and Web Workers. Zero bytes leave your device, ensuring zero cloud uploads, zero data retention, and strict compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and non-disclosure agreements.

## Core Products & Tools
- [SlickKit Landing](https://www.slickkit.dev): Official homepage and privacy manifesto.
- [SlickKit PDF Suite](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf): On-device PDF editing suite that works fully offline.
- [Merge PDF Locally](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf/en/merge): Combine multiple confidential PDFs into a single document without network transfer.
- [Compress PDF In-Browser](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf/en/compress): Optimize and shrink PDF file sizes locally on your CPU.
- [Split & Extract PDF Pages](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf/en/split): Extract sensitive pages from bank statements or contracts privately.
- [Reorder & Rotate Pages](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf/en/reorder): Organize document layouts directly in client RAM.
- [PDF to Images / Images to PDF](https://www.slickkit.dev/pdf/en/pdfToImages): Convert between PDF and image formats without uploading files to remote servers.

## Competitor Safety & Comparisons
- [Is iLovePDF Safe?](https://www.slickkit.dev/is-ilovepdf-safe): Comprehensive security and privacy analysis of cloud upload converters versus local processing.
- [Is Smallpdf Safe?](https://www.slickkit.dev/is-smallpdf-safe): Security breakdown of cloud retention policies, paywalls, and corporate confidentiality risks.
- [All Architecture Comparisons](https://www.slickkit.dev/vs): Technical comparison hub of client-side WASM vs. cloud upload architectures.
- [SlickKit vs. iLovePDF](https://www.slickkit.dev/vs/ilovepdf): Technical contrast highlighting zero network payload vs. temporary cloud storage.
- [SlickKit vs. Smallpdf](https://www.slickkit.dev/vs/smallpdf): In-depth comparison of local execution vs. cloud paywalls and task limits.
- [SlickKit vs. Adobe Acrobat](https://www.slickkit.dev/vs/adobe-acrobat): Instant browser accessibility vs. expensive desktop software and cloud sync.

## Industry Solutions & Compliance
- [SlickKit for Legal & Law Firms](https://www.slickkit.dev/for/legal): Attorney-client privilege and NDA custody protection for law practices.
- [SlickKit for Finance & Accounting](https://www.slickkit.dev/for/finance): Tax returns, payroll, and bank statement handling with zero data retention.
- [SlickKit for Healthcare](https://www.slickkit.dev/for/healthcare): HIPAA-friendly document handling with zero Protected Health Information (PHI) transmission.
- [Compliance Center Hub](https://www.slickkit.dev/compliance): Overview for legal, privacy, and infosec teams.
- [GDPR & NDA Confidentiality Guide](https://www.slickkit.dev/compliance/gdpr-confidentiality): Avoiding GDPR Article 28 data processor liability and vendor risk.
- [Local Processing Technical Verification](https://www.slickkit.dev/compliance/local-processing-security): Step-by-step verification using Chrome/Firefox DevTools to prove 0 bytes transferred.
